value.title: The pod template and pod folders (workstream 008 s01)
value.summary: A pod template is a folder at any path a command names (the main repo or governance); a pod is the running group made from it, with its own folder under `community/pods/<pod>/` on the governance branch. Memory is filed per role and subject, and a new pod can start without earlier pods' memory.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: A pod template is a folder at any path a command names (the main repo or governance); a pod is the running group made from it, with its own folder under `community/pods/<pod>/` on the governance branch. Memory is filed per role and subject, and a new pod can start without earlier pods' memory.

sections.name: goals
value: Define a recurring group of seats once, as files, and keep each running pod's record in governance.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Starting and stopping pods (plans 248, 249); shipped templates and adopt (PRD 010).

value.claim: Schemas `pij/pod-template` and `pij/pod` under `.dd/schemas/pij/`. A template: parameters (name, need), slots (role id, type, the parameters it uses, the tools it needs, a slot whose model it must not share, keep-open), wiring (which slot feeds which), per-slot seed text, consulted roles (role id, needed before up), deliverables (id, owner role, stages, write-back role) and its own procedures. Validated with ddocs; a slot naming an undeclared parameter refuses by name.
Every pod command takes the template's path; pij reads it where it is and records the path and version in the pod's folder. pij does not enforce where a template lives.

A pod folder `community/pods/<pod>/`: filled parameters, template path and version, slot to seat id, each first turn, a change log. Written only through the writer; a hand edit is refused by the next pod command naming the path. Seat facts are not copied.

Memory per role and subject: a member's notes are filed under its role and the pod's subject; two subjects never share notes; `pod up --fresh` leaves the memory index out of every first turn and says so.
The words are pod and pod template only; the docs and help use no others.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Role documents and the writer (crates/daemon/src/community/role.rs, writer.rs); memory (community/memory.rs); first turns (community/first_turn.rs, plan 241).

value.risk: A template outside governance changes between plan and up.
value.mitigation: The pod records the template's path and content hash at up; show names both.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: on demand only: reading a template is in-process; writing a pod folder is the writer's usual commit. No loop, poll or timer.
No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
